Automatic email testing

After generating a batch, ACO Studio will test its addresses automatically when a matching saved sender/receiver configuration is available. Test All Unverified starts with 3 preflight emails per catch-all inbox. If none arrive, it pauses instead of sending hundreds more. After preflight, it tests in groups of 25. Green means delivered, amber means not confirmed in Inbox, and red means the sending server rejected the message.

Automatic testing starts after each generated batch when matching secure mail credentials are saved.

Mail accounts & forwarding settings (securely remembered)

Save sender and receiver app passwords once. You can store multiple pairs and swap them without replacing existing credentials. Test messages are moved to Trash in both inbox and Sent when confirmed delivered. No other mail is touched.

Live routing means Cloudflare says the rule is live, or catch-all delivery was verified. Delivery verified means a real test reached the selected inbox. No email is assigned to a retailer from this panel without your explicit confirmation.

Export may include unverified drafts when you select them. Email Gen CSV uses its import-only preset password, not a real mailbox password. Exporting never publishes or assigns anything.

Remove a generated batch

Delete acts on the selected batch only. It never deletes other batches or retailer profiles. Address-specific Cloudflare rules are not deleted remotely. Batches already imported into retailer pools must be unlinked there first.

Older generated emails are grouped by saved creation timestamps when they lack a batch ID. Manual aliases remain available in the Email Bank table below.
